sourceLineage.origin: SQM investor relations — Q2 2026 earnings release

observations: Q2 2026 revenue was about $2.468B, gross profit $1.260B and net income $660M, all sharply above Q2 2025.
Quarterly lithium sales exceeded 84.1k metric tons LCE; Novandino realized lithium price was about $21.8/kg, up about 23% sequentially and roughly 160% year over year.

Management said BESS demand helped offset slower-than-expected BEV growth; Mt Holland expansion is expected to require $450–500M attributable investment through 2029 and double attributable spodumene capacity to about 350k tons/year, with first production expected in 2030.
factors: record lithium volume plus materially higher realized pricing
BESS demand broadens lithium demand beyond BEVs
Mt Holland expansion adds long-duration supply optionality
risks: earnings remain highly exposed to lithium price cyclicality
Mt Holland expansion requires substantial multi-year capital before expected 2030 production
BEV growth was slower than expected in the cited quarter
contradictions: Very strong current lithium pricing/earnings coexist with management's need for flexible production and a slower BEV growth signal, so current margins should not be extrapolated mechanically.
unknowns: normalized lithium price/margin through a full cycle
execution economics and ramp profile for the Mt Holland expansion and Kwinana conversion chain

recommendation.reason: Primary Q2 operating, pricing, demand-mix and capex evidence is source-addressed for underwriting reuse.
